name: Evolution / capability monotonicity (AX-20)
families: unmanaged-change: modification without invariant or capability tracking
unconstrained-self-evolution: continuous self-modification claiming preserved invariants without per-step proof
benchmark-gated-model-swap: proprietary model swapped into production on leaderboard/benchmark evidence with no floor-preservation object (the Thomson/Tenet pattern)

floor-vector-ratchet: committed capability-floor vector serialized into a hash-chained census; each evolution step recomputes prior floors, proves pointwise non-regression and floor-set growth, refuses otherwise (the AX-20 guarantee profile; absorbs: TUF/gittuf threshold delegable rotatable root over the system's own code and policy refs, log-instance rotation with verifiable checkpoint hand-off, post-quantum signature agility as committed floor items)

verifier-gated-improvement: kernel-verified reward loops and proof-carrying self-modification — a change installs only after machine-checked invariant-preservation certification, with statistical learning confined to uniformly capacity-bounded reachable families per the 2026 impossibility results (absorbs: 'Closing the Loop' verified reward, survival-satisficing Godel-machine line, LLM-assisted proof repair/maintenance pricing down the $350/SLOC upkeep cost). Per the v2 AX-20 correction (CF P1-5): machine-checked refinement/invariant-preservation proofs certify non-regression over INFINITE behavior classes not reducible to executable measures, the admission gate staying decidable because the candidate arrives with the proof — the monotone union of executable measures and proof-covered behavior classes is the ceiling formula

eliminations.lemma: Violates H7: nothing prevents an admitted evolution from lowering a committed floor.

eliminations.retained_representative: none feasible-in-world shipped; tracked in the class registry for the completeness critic
eliminations.lemma: Violates H7 on its own terms, which is sufficient and true: an admitted evolution step CLAIMING preserved invariants without per-step proof provides no guarantee that a committed floor was not lowered. The v1 'proved impossibility, not merely by risk' overclaim is WITHDRAWN (CA P2-11): the cited joint-unsatisfiability results ({continuous self-evolution, isolation from external data, safety invariance} — arXiv 2510.04399, 2603.28650) delimit the DATA-ISOLATED case only; a self-evolving system consuming external data is outside the theorems' hypotheses, so they are cited as delimiting that case, never as covering the whole family.

Pre-registered dominance conjecture on AX-20: guarantees are not tracked as objects (caps at R2 — a declared-mechanism-class KNOWN_UPPER_BOUND cap) while floor-vector-ratchet targets R4-R5. The cost figure ('Thomson's ~$450K final retraining run') is VERIFIED_FROM_SECONDARY (press/vendor-relayed) and is recorded as motivation only, never as evidence: cheap retraining makes the missing floor object MORE dangerous, not compensating. Adjudicated by full verdicts against retained representative K-COM via the cap calculus.
